label: rejected

evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a round-canopy tree from front, three-quarter and top (lobed blob on a thin trunk); generic lollipop but recognisable at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Big canopy and medium trunk are clear, but the two branches are barely visible stubs hidden under the canopy (a dark notch in the fork close-up) and there is no small-scale detail (no root flare, bark, leaf clusters).
evidence.V3: Trunk is a straight, untapered column and the canopy a single puffy blob; only partly stylised, reads stiff rather than a confident chunky oak.
evidence.V4: Canopy lobes are soft, but the trunk base ends in a hard flat slab flare with a sharp band (trunk_base close-up) and the trunk sides are plain; edge treatment inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Canopy close-up in studio light shows a visible quad grid / faceting across the lobes and creased pinch lines where lobes merge; trunk is clean. Minor but visible.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one foliage green plus bark brown, good value contrast; colourways (autumn, frost) swap only the canopy hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1876 tris vs tree target 2000 (ceiling 5000): at target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material and kit palette, but canopy grid faceting and single flat green value fall short of the smooth weighted-normal kit finish; minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only part option), CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre: correct.

evidence.V1: Lobed round canopy on a straight trunk reads as a broadleaf tree in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view is a lumpy green blob but still reads as canopy.
evidence.V2: Big canopy and trunk only; canopy lobes are soft and shallow, branches are hidden inside the canopy (branch-fork close-up shows only bare trunk), and there is no small detail.
evidence.V3: Thin straight boxy trunk under a swollen blob canopy reads as a lollipop tree; no trunk taper, root flare or limb structure to give oak character.
evidence.V4: Canopy is a soft blobby shell with no defined lobe edges, while the trunk base ends in a hard flat square lip; edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Canopy close-up (studio) and all colourways show a visible quad-grid shading pattern across the foliage shell; trunk top shows a hard notch where the canopy meets it.
evidence.V6: One foliage hue in 2 values plus bark brown secondary; autumn and blossom colourways keep the same discipline.
evidence.V7: 1876 tris vs tree target 2000 - under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material and correct palette, but the grid-shaded canopy and squared box trunk fall short of the smooth weighted-normal fused shells the kit specifies.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only part option for walk-through canopy), CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

evidence.V1: Lollipop broadleaf tree reads clearly in front, 3/4 and silhouette (lobed canopy on a straight trunk); top view is a lumpy green blob, acceptable for a canopy.
evidence.V2: Big canopy and medium trunk read, but the small tier is missing: the two branches are buried (branch-fork close-up shows only a V-notch at the trunk top, a tiny stub in the front view) and the canopy is one shell with soft bulges.
evidence.V3: Canopy lobes are pleasantly cloud-like, but the trunk is a stiff straight near-square tube with no taper or root flare beyond a thin dark collar; partly stylised.
evidence.V4: Canopy is a smooth fused shell (fine), but the trunk shows hard near-square corners and a flat sock-like base band with a sharp step (trunk-base close-up); inconsistent treatment.
evidence.V5: Canopy shows a faint quad-grid lattice/checker in the studio shading (canopy close-up, frost and autumn colourways) and the trunk side has a long vertical shading crease; minor but visible.
evidence.V6: Foliage green in 2-3 values plus bark brown in two values; colourways (autumn, frost) swap cleanly.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and nature palette fit, but the grid-patterned canopy shading and boxy trunk differ from the smooth-shell kit look.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only part for walk-through canopies), CanTouch off, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white, origin bottom-centre.

top_fixes: Smooth/weight the canopy normals (more subdivision or normal transfer) to remove the grid faceting and lobe-join creases
Give the trunk taper, a slight lean and a rounded root flare instead of the flat slab base
Make the branches read: extend them out of the canopy underside and add 2-3 smaller leaf clumps for small-scale hierarchy
Add a second/third foliage value (lighter top, darker underside) via vertex colour
Smooth the canopy shell (more subdivision or weighted normals) to remove the grid shading, and sculpt 3-5 distinct puff lobes with clear dips
Give the trunk a round tapered profile with a root flare and let 2-3 visible limbs fork into the canopy
Add a small tier: a few leaf-clump puffs breaking the canopy outline or a knot on the trunk
Fix canopy normals / increase smoothing so the quad grid does not show (weighted normals, merge-by-distance on fused lobes)
Expose the branches: let 2-3 limbs fork out below the canopy so the small tier reads
Taper the trunk and give it a rounded cross-section with a proper root flare instead of the flat dark base band
Add 1-2 lower secondary canopy clumps for a stronger lobed oak silhouette
